title: RECREG: Recovery-based Shielding for Regular Safety Properties in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23445v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In many real-world scenarios we need to consider formal requirements, such as safety and constraint compliance, to deploy Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. In this paper we introduce RecReg, a safe RL framework capable of enforcing non-Markovian regular safety properties via recovery-based shielding. RecReg is a unified approach that supports different levels of a priori knowledge and safety guarantees. The paper primarily focuses on building the theoretical foundations for RecReg in the tabular setting, providing rigorous safety and convergence guarantees that are not present in related work. We provide an extensive set of empirical results using the MASA-Safe-RL library, and we outline an extension of RecReg to deep RL domains using SOTA model-based RL. Our empirical results demonstrate that RecReg achieves efficient learning and matches the theory in this paper.

translated_title: RECREG：强化学习中针对正则安全性质的基于恢复的屏蔽方法
translated_abstract: 在许多现实场景中，部署强化学习（RL）智能体时需要考虑形式化要求，例如安全性和约束合规性。本文提出了RecReg，一个安全强化学习框架，能够通过基于恢复的屏蔽机制强制执行非马尔可夫的正则安全性质。RecReg是一种统一的方法，支持不同层次的先验知识和安全保证。本文主要侧重于在表格型设置中为RecReg构建理论基础，提供了现有相关工作所不具备的严格的安全性和收敛性保证。我们使用MASA-Safe-RL库提供了大量的实证结果，并概述了利用最先进的基于模型的强化学习将RecReg扩展到深度强化学习领域的方案。实验结果表明，RecReg实现了高效学习，且与本文的理论相吻合。
tldr: RecReg是一个通过基于恢复的屏蔽机制强制执行非马尔可夫正则安全性质的安全强化学习框架，并首次提供了严格的安全性和收敛性理论保证。
